args.target: T027 design-system compliance: refresh buttons and tracking section use Graphite Mint tokens

args.label: Button is the secondary button: transparent fill, text colour, strong line, no glow, 36px high

args.condition: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.rescrape button')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.rescrape button')).borderTopColor === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--line-strong)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

[...document.querySelectorAll('.rescrape button')].every(b => getComputedStyle(b).backgroundColor !== (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--neon)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })())

args.label: Hover uses the raised surface; focus ring is 2px solid neon with a 2px offset

args.condition: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.rescrape button')).backgroundColor === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--bg-raised)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.activeElement).outlineStyle === 'solid' && getComputedStyle(document.activeElement).outlineWidth === '2px' && getComputedStyle(document.activeElement).outlineOffset === '2px' && getComputedStyle(document.activeElement).outlineColor === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--neon)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

args.label: Tracking text: mono, muted; no data in text-dim; group list outlined with line, no shadow, links in accent

args.condition: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[aria-labelledby=h-tracking] .meta')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.group-list')).borderTopColor === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--line)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.group-list li a')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--accent)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.group-list li span')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#h-tracking')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text-strong)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[aria-labelledby=h-tracking] .gm-nodata')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text-dim)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

args.label: Status line: mono, text-2 when queued; danger colour with the word 'failed' on error

args.condition: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.rescrape__status')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text-2)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })() && getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.rescrape__status')).fontFamily.startsWith('"IBM Plex Mono"')

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.rescrape__status')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--danger)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })() && document.querySelector('.rescrape__status').classList.contains('rescrape__status--error')
